about.heading: About Sri Sakthi Lodge
about.defaultBody: Sri Sakthi Lodge is a budget lodge in Kanyakumari District, Tamil Nadu. We offer A/C and non-A/C rooms for different group sizes, so you can choose what suits your stay. You can book online, or call or WhatsApp us and we will help.
about.roomTypesBody: Single Bed, Double Bed, Three Bed, Five Bed, Standard A/C, Deluxe A/C and A/C Suite. Availability and rates are shown live when you search.
about.helpBody: Call or WhatsApp us and we will help you choose a room.

amenities.parkingDesc: Car parking is available opposite the lodge, about 200 m away (not inside the property).
amenities.breakfastDesc: Breakfast is served 8:00 – 10:00 AM. Please confirm with the lodge when booking.

sunrise.name: Kanyakumari Sunrise
sunrise.description: Kanyakumari is well known for watching the sunrise over the sea. Ask the lodge for the best viewing spots and timings.

vivekananda.name: Vivekananda Rock Memorial
vivekananda.description: A well-known memorial on a rock just off the Kanyakumari shore, reached by ferry.

thiruvalluvar.name: Thiruvalluvar Statue
thiruvalluvar.description: A large statue of the Tamil poet-saint Thiruvalluvar, standing near the Kanyakumari shore.

temples.name: Local temples

parking.a: Car parking is available opposite the lodge, about 200 m away. It is not inside the property.

wifi.a: Yes, Wi-Fi is available for guests.

payment.a: You can pay an advance online (Razorpay / UPI), pay through PhonePe, or pay cash at the lodge.

lateCheckout.a: Late check-out is subject to availability and is not guaranteed. Between 11 AM and 1 PM it is free; from 1 PM to 5 PM up to 30% of that day's room rate may be charged; after 5 PM the full day's rate is charged.

extension.a: Extensions are subject to availability. Extra nights are charged at the rate that is current at that time, not the rate of your original booking.

cancel.q: How do I cancel a booking?
cancel.a: You can cancel through this website using your booking reference. Refunds, where applicable, are credited within 7 days and you will be asked for your bank details.

liquor.q: Is liquor allowed in the rooms?
liquor.a: No. Liquor is not allowed in the rooms.

policies.heading: Lodge policies
policies.intro: Here is what you need to know before you stay. Please contact us if anything is unclear.
policies.draftBody: The lodge is still confirming a few details (for example the exact check-out time and whether breakfast applies to every booking). Please ask us when you book.
policies.checkOutPending: The check-out time is being confirmed by the lodge. Please ask when you book.
policies.lateCheckoutText: Late check-out is subject to availability and is not guaranteed.
policies.latePartial: 1:00 PM – 5:00 PM: up to 30% of that day's room rate.
policies.lateFull: After 5:00 PM: 100% of that day's room rate.
policies.extensionText: Extending your stay is subject to availability. Extra nights are charged at the current rate on the day, not the rate of your original booking.
policies.paymentsText: You can pay an advance online (Razorpay / UPI), pay with PhonePe, or pay cash at the lodge.
policies.rulesNoLiquor: Liquor is not allowed in the rooms.
policies.rulesDamage: Guests are responsible for any damage to the lodge's property.
policies.cancellationText: Bookings are cancelled through this website. Where a refund applies, it is credited within 7 days and you will be asked for your bank details.
policies.cancellationPending: Whether a refund applies to every type of booking is being confirmed by the lodge.

cancellationPage.heading: Cancellation policy
cancellationPage.howText: Use "Find my booking" on this website with your booking reference and phone number, then choose "Cancel booking".
cancellationPage.refundsText: Where a refund applies, it is credited within 7 days. You will be asked to provide your bank details so the refund can be sent.
cancellationPage.pendingText: The lodge is confirming how the policy applies to every booking type. No cancellation deadlines or refund percentages are published yet – please ask us before you pay if you need to know.

termsPage.heading: Terms and conditions
termsPage.bookingsText: A booking is confirmed only when the lodge's system shows it as confirmed. Rooms are subject to availability.
termsPage.draftNotice: These terms are a plain-language summary of the lodge's current rules and are being reviewed. They are not legal advice.

privacyPage.heading: Privacy policy
privacyPage.draftNotice: This is a plain-language description of the personal information this website handles. It is being reviewed by the lodge and does not claim compliance with any specific law.
privacyPage.collectIntro: We only collect what is needed to handle bookings, enquiries and reviews:
privacyPage.collect1: Booking details: name, mobile number, email (if you give it), dates, number of guests and any notes you add.
privacyPage.collect2: Enquiries: the name, phone, email and message you send through the contact form.
privacyPage.collect3: Reviews: the name and review text you choose to submit.
privacyPage.collect4: Refund details: bank details you provide when cancelling a paid booking. These are sent securely to the lodge and not stored in your browser.
privacyPage.collect5: Payment information: card or UPI details are entered with Razorpay, not on this website. We receive only a payment confirmation.
privacyPage.collect6: A cookie that remembers your language choice.
privacyPage.useText: To confirm and manage your stay, reply to your questions, process payments and refunds, and publish reviews you agree to share.
privacyPage.shareText: Lodge staff, and our service providers where needed (for example the payment provider). We do not sell your information.
privacyPage.idText: This website does not ask you to upload ID documents. The lodge may ask to see ID when you arrive.
privacyPage.choicesText: Contact the lodge to ask about, correct or remove your information.
